set.question: In Spain, which question is correct for vosotros (informal)?

why: "correcta" is in no vocabulary list; ask in English.
Friends in Spain say vosotros, not ustedes (unit teaches habéis in the same lesson).
why_unmatched: marked variant es-es: holds only there
